housing.summary: Lausanne is a major Francophone hub on Lake Geneva. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,882/month per Numbeo (Sep 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence (attestation d'établissement), and permit if non-EU. Main banks in Lausanne: UBS and Banque Cantonale Vaudoise (BCV). PostFinance and Raiffeisen branches also operate locally.
required_docs: Proof of Swiss address registration (attestation d'établissement)
Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Lausanne has a well-established international school sector, partly driven by the Olympic Committee (IOC) headquarters and international organisations. Schools include Institut Le Rosey (nearby), Brillantmont International School, and École Nouvelle de la Suisse Romande. IB and French Baccalaureate are widely offered.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the contrôle des habitants of their commune within 8 days of arriving in canton Vaud (stricter than federal 14-day rule). EU/EFTA nationals receive permit B or L from the cantonal migration office (Service de la population, SPOP). Non-EU nationals need a cantonal permit before arrival. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) is assigned by the cantonal compensation office (Caisse cantonale vaudoise de compensation, CCVD) or employer. Vaud applies cantonal income and wealth taxes. Foreign residents without a C-permit are subject to withholding tax (impôt à la source).

transport.summary: Lausanne's public transport is operated by TL (Transports Lausannois), including the famous metro (M2), buses and trolleybuses. A monthly pass costs approximately CHF 78 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Service des automobiles (SAN VD) without a test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung (assurance-maladie) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Service des automobiles et de la navigation (SAN, vd.ch); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (assurance-maladie/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
